description: Spanish prose quality: complete ideas, punctuation cuts that follow meaning, no one-word fragments, no em dash.
rubric: The text is written in natural Spanish. Each sentence expresses a complete idea and can be understood without the previous one. There are no truncated fragments, no one- or two-word sentences used as a rhetorical punch, and no ideas left half-finished. Punctuation and sentence length vary, but the breaks fall where the meaning falls: no period, comma, or semicolon separates a subject from its verb or splits an idea in half. The text does not end with a generic closing line. It fails if any of these conditions is not met.

cases.prompt: Escribe en español un comentario de PR de 4 a 6 frases sobre una función `reintentar()` que no usa backoff exponencial.
Redacta en español un email breve para avisar que el deploy se retrasó un día por un test inestable.
Explica en español, en un solo párrafo de unas 6 oraciones, qué es un cache LRU y cuándo conviene usarlo.
